cards.title: Drug Effect Model Slope Estimation
cards.claim: For NCA drug effect models, Phoenix estimates two slopes: Slope 1 (beginning of data) and Slope 2 (end of data). It uses the same adjusted R² selection logic as Lambda Z (min 3 points) but allows linear or log regression and does not negate the slope (can be positive or negative). If only one range is specified, the other is automatically determined.
conditions: Applicable to drug effect (PD) models, not just concentration PK.
Regression can be linear or log-transformed.
required_inputs: Optional user-specified ranges for Slope 1 or 2
limitations: Same point-count and data validity constraints as Lambda Z (min 3 points for automatic selection).
cards.downstream_use: Quantifies onset and offset kinetics of pharmacodynamic effects.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
